# Campaign 1 - Storyteller Overview

Storyteller eyes only. The player-facing version of this material is [[Campaign 1 Blurb]].

## Premise

New York, autumn 2001. The Camarilla has held the city for two years and holds it badly. The Nosferatu elder [[Calebros]] has run the court as a caretaker since the takeover and has announced that he will step down before the end of the year. Every ambitious Kindred in the five boroughs has started counting votes, favours and knives.

## The succession crisis

Three names matter. [[Marleina]] of the Ventrue has the Primogen's ear and the most boons to call in; she wins the election unless the player's actions make that impossible. [[Hakim Olamaz]] of the Tremere does not want the throne but wants to choose who sits on it. [[Rene Valentine]] of the Toreador controls the social calendar and therefore controls who is seen talking to whom.

## The hidden truth

Something older than the Camarilla sleeps under the abandoned Fenwick Street pumping station. The Nosferatu know that the lower tunnels are wrong but not why. Kindred who go too deep come back changed or do not come back. This is the spine of the chronicle; the election is the noise around it.

## Structure

- Act 1: Rene Valentine's masquerade ball, first introductions, first debts, the first rumour from below.
- Act 2: the election heats up, a hunter cell starts working the Lower East Side, the Tremere chantry takes an interest in the tunnels.
- Act 3: the descent beneath Fenwick Street and whatever the player chooses to do with what they find.

## Adaptability notes

- A Tremere player character gets [[Hakim Olamaz]] as a difficult mentor.
- A Malkavian player character hears [[Eleazar]] before meeting him.
- A character with mortal family gives the hunters something to find.
- Eleazar may speak as if he knows he is in a story. Use it once, late, and only if the player plays along.
